page.$description: Screen background when content sits straight on it, with no cards. Forms and full-bleed pages.

page-strong.$description: Screen background behind cards and lists. The default page colour in the app.

primary.$description: The main container colour: cards, lists, sheets, app bar, bottom navigation, input fields.

secondary.$description: A quiet fill inside a primary surface: filled cards, skeleton base, disabled-looking areas. Never on page-strong, where it disappears.

tertiary.$description: A stronger neutral fill: selected bottom-nav pill, neutral subtle badge, skeleton shimmer.

neutral-subtle.$description: See-through neutral fill: tonal icon buttons, segmented-control tracks, and the pressed and hover state layer on every button. It darkens whatever is behind it, so it never merges with the page.

disabled.$description: Fill for disabled inputs and buttons.

mds.note: Dark was gray/600, the same as Content/disabled, so disabled labels vanished.

inverse.$description: Dark fill on a light screen: filled neutral badge, count badge, tooltips.

overlay.$description: Scrim behind bottom sheets and dialogs.

action-primary.$description: The CTA fill. Primary button and filled icon button only. Pressed adds the neutral-subtle state layer on top.

action-secondary.$description: Fills of controls that are on: checked checkbox, switch track. Shapes only, never behind text.

action-secondary-bold.$description: Blue fill that carries white text: filled accent badge. Follows the -subtle / -bold pattern of the status colours.

action-secondary-subtle.$description: Selected chip background, list-item leads, empty-state art.

positive-subtle.$description: Background of subtle success banners and badges.

positive-bold.$description: Filled success badges and banners and anything else that carries white text on the positive colour.

mds.note: Was the 400 shade, with a separate -strong token for white text. Merged into one: -bold is now the dark shade, so it always passes 4.5:1 with Content/onDark.

negative-subtle.$description: Background of subtle error banners and badges.

negative-bold.$description: Filled error badges and banners and anything else that carries white text on the negative colour.

mds.note: Was the 400 shade, with a separate -strong token for white text. Merged into one: -bold is now the dark shade, so it always passes 4.5:1 with Content/onDark.

warning-subtle.$description: Background of subtle warning banners and badges.

warning-bold.$description: Filled warning badges and banners and anything else that carries white text on the warning colour.

mds.note: Was the 400 shade, with a separate -strong token for white text. Merged into one: -bold is now the dark shade, so it always passes 4.5:1 with Content/onDark.

info-subtle.$description: Background of subtle info banners and badges.

info-bold.$description: Filled info badges and banners and anything else that carries white text on the info colour.

mds.note: Was the 400 shade, with a separate -strong token for white text. Merged into one: -bold is now the dark shade, so it always passes 4.5:1 with Content/onDark.

nudge.$description: The one colour for notification markers: count badges and unread dots, everywhere in the app.

secondary.$description: Supporting text: subtitles, helper text, descriptions, unselected tabs and nav items.

tertiary.$description: Timestamps and meta at 12px and up. 3.6:1 on white, so never for sentences people must read.

placeholder.$description: Placeholder text inside input fields only.

disabled.$description: Text and icons on disabled controls, on Surface/disabled.

mds.note: Dark was gray/800 in Semantic and gray/600 in Semantic-Dark: invisible on Surface/primary and on Surface/disabled.

onDark.$description: Text on fills that stay dark in both modes: -bold status fills, action-secondary-bold, nudge.

onLight.$description: Text on light fills that stay light in both modes: the CTA yellow.

action.$description: Link text, link buttons, selected chip and tab labels.

mds.note: Light was ClearBlue-400 (3.9:1 on white). Dark was ClearBlue-400, which disappears on the dark selected-chip tint (ClearBlue-700).
Was green/400: 4.1:1 on white and 3.8:1 on dark.
Light was orange/600: 4.1:1 on white, 3.6:1 on warning-subtle.
Dark was blue/400: 3.1:1 on dark surfaces.

action-outlined.$description: Text and icons in outlined accent badges and banners. Light uses the same primitive as Content/action; Dark uses the same primitive as Border/action, so the text matches its outline.

positive-outlined.$description: Text and icons in outlined success badges and banners. Light uses the same primitive as Content/positive; Dark uses the same primitive as Border/positive, so the text matches its outline.

negative-outlined.$description: Text and icons in outlined error badges and banners. Light uses the same primitive as Content/negative; Dark uses the same primitive as Border/negative, so the text matches its outline.

warning-outlined.$description: Text and icons in outlined warning badges and banners. Light uses the same primitive as Content/warning; Dark uses the same primitive as Border/warning, so the text matches its outline.

info-outlined.$description: Text and icons in outlined info badges and banners. Light uses the same primitive as Content/info; Dark uses the same primitive as Border/info, so the text matches its outline.

subtle.$description: Dividers inside a card or list.

default.$description: Card outlines, list containers, app bar and bottom nav edges.

dark.$description: Input fields, secondary buttons, unchecked checkboxes and radios. 3:1 on white, so controls stay visible.

action.$description: Focused field, checked checkbox and radio, selected chip, active tab underline.

focus.$description: The 3px keyboard focus ring on every interactive element.

negative.$description: Field in error, outlined error banners and badges.

primary.$description: Same as Surface/action-primary. Use that instead.

secondary.$description: Same as Surface/action-secondary. Use that instead.

secondary-subtle.$description: Same as Surface/action-secondary-subtle, but without a dark mode. Use that instead.

expressive1.$description: Illustration and category colour. Never for controls or text.

expressive4.$description: Exists only in the Semantic-Dark collection today. Add it to Semantic.

accent5.$description: Rename to expressive5 to match the others.

PrivateInvite.$description: Private-invite feature colour. Feature-specific: consider a feature collection.
